RK4_tangent.stage_sensitivity: For stage z_j, D_x f=f_x(z_j)*X_j; D_u f=f_x(z_j)*U_j+f_u(z_j). Intermediate stage X_j/U_j use corresponding earlier stage derivative; combine with identical RK4 weights.
RK4_tangent.composition: For substep Jacobians Jx_j,Ju_j: X_next=Jx_j*X; U_next=Jx_j*U+Ju_j; shared held u throughout all substeps.
RK4_tangent.physical: Use accepted DynamicBicycle.step held pair for value comparison, 2 or20 steps of0.005; physical geometry refreshed at every derivative stage; lift completed-step wrap before residual/tangent comparisons.
RK4_tangent.frozen: Use exact SymbolicBicycle.rk4 dt/substeps and held scalar kappa; no geometry resampling at symbolic stages.
prohibited_substitutions: NLP shooting map for actual event-split application map
CasADi function hidden inside independent finite-difference value routine

finite_difference.scheme: central differences of independently implemented matching NumPy f/F
finite_difference.rule: abs(J-Dh)<=abs_tol+rel_tol*max(abs(J),abs(Dh)); also two smallest Dh agree by same rule
finite_difference.boundaries: No clamp, no silent step adjustment; unavailable or explicitly one-sided at knot/wrap/domain boundary

parity_rules: Normalize A/B output and column perturbations with accepted Dx/Du and continuous tau; central steps exactly [2e-5,1e-5,5e-6] times column scales.
Entry bound: abs(J-Dh)<=1e-7+1e-4*max(abs(J),abs(Dh)); require two-smallest-step agreement by same bound. Store every entry/column/step error and observed cancellation.
Geometry kappa_s uses s steps [2e-5,1e-5,5e-6] m, abs1e-5 1/m^2 plus rel1e-3, within a single qualified segment.
If one method rejects a stencil/domain, report missing comparison for that precise key rather than set error=0 or silently change tuple.
Different curvature policies/nominal tuples are a separately labeled model-difference report, not pass/fail parity.
Derivative failure preserves all numbers and stops affected quantitative conclusion; no repeated favorable-run replacement.

matrix_units.normalized: dimensionless with tau=1 s for continuous pairs; raw units always retained

no_evaluated_results: All map/derivative/FD results remain NOT EXECUTED; NULL scientific values in any unexecuted status record, never literal oracles presented as candidate data.
